summary: Worthington Steel GmbH, an indirect wholly-owned subsidiary of Worthington Steel, Inc., signed a Domination and Profit and Loss Transfer Agreement (DPLTA) on September 8, 2026 with Kloeckner Co SE, a German Societas Europaea, acting as controlling company. Subject to Kloeckner shareholder approval by qualified majority and Handelsregister registration, effective no earlier than January 1, 2027, Worthington may issue binding management board instructions, receive Kloeckner's annual profits, and absorb losses. Outside shareholders receive elective cash compensation of EUR 11.00 per share under AktG §305 or recurring annual EUR 0.67 gross (EUR 0.66 net) per share under §304. German appraisal proceedings (Spruchverfahren) may challenge compensation adequacy without delaying registration. Watch registration timing, shareholder litigation, and any higher court-awarded compensation as the key risk-arb variables.
